# BG collision attribute tables (bank 9, page = k1 $69), tools/bg_coll_dump.py

## total bit counts over all pages b0..b7: 14 1743 1536 129 211 18 107 17
## bit meanings (from ObjBgProbe / 26:9947 / PlayerMove)
  b0 pit for the player (PlayerStatusTick 31:F068); blocks non-player objects (mask $27)
  b1 low obstacle: blocks the player (mask $32) on the ground and in a normal jump (s77 emu); only flight / warp-exit (mask $34) cross it
  b2 wall: blocks the player with either mask ($32/$34)
  b3 visited-substitutable metatile
  b4 -> obj_flags b4 (draw behind BG)
  b5 conveyor/current (PlayerConveyor); blocks non-player objects
  b6 -> obj_flags b6 (sink, speed-2)
  b7 damage floor: -4 HP every 32 $08 ticks on the ground (PlayerStatusTick; s77 emu)
